sources.content: The gorsefield-proxy image runs the Gorsefield reverse proxy. It is built on debian:12-slim and runs as the non-root user gorse with user ID 7001. It listens for HTTP on port 8080 and HTTPS on port 8443. Route definitions are read from /etc/gorsefield/routes.yaml. Mount a volume at /var/cache/gorsefield to keep the response cache across restarts. The entrypoint is /opt/gorsefield/bin/gorsefield, and the image sets no default command arguments. The compressed image is about 40 MB.

GORSEFIELD_WORKERS sets the number of worker threads and defaults to 4. GORSEFIELD_CACHE_SIZE sets the response cache size and defaults to 512m. Set GORSEFIELD_ACME_EMAIL to request certificates automatically from an ACME provider; when it is unset, the proxy expects certificate files in /etc/gorsefield/certs. Access logs use the combined format. The health check requests /_gorse/health on port 8080 every 20 seconds, with a 3 second timeout. Set GORSEFIELD_LOG_LEVEL to debug for verbose output; it defaults to info.

claims.text: The gorsefield-proxy image listens for HTTPS on port 443.
The gorsefield-proxy health check runs every 20 seconds.
The gorsefield-proxy image runs as user ID 7001.
